deep.reconstruction:
This page holds no mathematics by Riemann. It is the end of an editorial letter from Heinrich Weber, dated Königsberg, 21 January 1876. Weber was co-editor, with Dedekind, of the first edition of Riemann's Gesammelte Werke (1876). The letter, presumably to the printer or publisher (Teubner), lists corrections to proof sheet 19 ('Bogen 19'). That sheet contains the posthumous paper 'Über die Fläche vom kleinsten Inhalt bei gegebener Begrenzung', edited by Hattendorff.

The previous page gave the substantive corrections. On p. 298 the text is to say that the quotient H = K2:K1 gives an image of the positive t-half-plane on the sphere bounded by arcs of great circles. On p. 299, θ is real and α, α' are conjugate complex quantities. On p. 301, last line, '7' becomes '10'. On p. 302, a remark is inserted: of the real constants b, c, e, ... three may be given arbitrary values by a linear substitution of t with real coefficients.

This page adds the last correction: on p. 302, line 4 from the top, the numbers '7' and '3' are to be changed to '10' and '6'. Weber then notes that Professor (H. A.) Schwarz has sent his own corrected copy directly. He therefore asks for second revisions (proofs) of Bogen 19. Signed 'Ergebenst ... H. Weber'.

My interpretation (not stated on the page): the corrections raise each constant count by 3 (7→10 and 3→6). This fits the inserted remark that real Möbius substitutions of t, a 3-parameter group PSL(2,R), allow three of the real constants to be normalised. The corrected text apparently counts all real parameters first and only then subtracts the 3 removable ones. This reflects Schwarz's work on Riemann's minimal-surface problem for polygonal boundaries (e.g. the skew quadrilateral).
errors: No mathematical content to check on this page. The corrections themselves concern counts of constants in the edited Riemann paper. They are consistent with the 3-dimensional freedom of real linear-fractional substitutions, but cannot be verified from this page alone.

results.what: Editorial correction of constant counts (7→10, 3→6) in Riemann's minimal-surface paper, prompted by H. A. Schwarz's corrections
results.modern_name: Parameter counting for Schwarz–Christoffel-type / Riemann–Schwarz minimal surfaces with polygonal boundary; normalisation by PSL(2,R) (3 real parameters)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (posthumous, ed. Hattendorff 1867); corrections by H. A. Schwarz, edition by Weber & Dedekind 1876

deep.surprise_reason: This is an 1876 editorial letter by H. Weber about proof corrections for Riemann's Werke, not a Riemann manuscript with new mathematics. The role of Schwarz and Weber in editing the minimal-surface paper is well documented.

checkable.asserts: Both corrections raise the constant count by the same amount, 3.

checkable.sympy: Matrix([[a,b],[c,d]]) with a*d-b*c=1 over reals has 4-1 = 3 free real parameters
checkable.asserts: The real Möbius group PSL(2,R) acting on the t-half-plane has dimension 3, so three real constants can be normalised.

transcription_corrections: 'Endlich S. 102 Z. 4 v. o.' should read 'Endlich S. 302 Z. 4 v. o.'. The image shows 302, consistent with the previous page's 'Pag. 302'; the abbreviation may be 'Pag.' or 'S.'.
The author is H. Weber (Heinrich Weber), not Riemann. The page is an editorial letter dated Königsberg, 21 Jan 1876.
